HEADER: Init +8; Senses Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +33
DEFENSE: AC 32, touch 12, flat-footed 28 (+4 Dex, +20 natural, -2 size)
OFFENSE: Speed 30 ft., climb 20 ft., fly 40 ft. (good)
Melee bite +29 (2d8+10/19-20 plus confusion), 4 claws +28 (1d4+10 plus grab), 4 wings +26 (1d4+5 plus poison), tail slap +26 (2d6+5 plus blind)
Special Attacks Breath Wing, constrict (2d8+10), Cold Wave, Gates of Hades, Maelstrom, Umbral Storm
STATISTICS: Str 31, Dex 18, Con 28, Int 12, Wis 23, Cha 12
Base Atk +20; CMB +32 (+36 grapple); CMD 46 (cannot be tripped)

Feats Ability Focus (Encircle), Improved Critical (Bite), Improved Critical (Quarterstaff), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Focus (Bite)
Skills Bluff +21, Climb +18, Fly +27, Perception +33; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Alternate Form (su) At will as a standard action, a jura aevis may take on a humanoid disguise, becoming an ancient human man. This is a polymorph ability, except that the jura aevis's stat block becomes that of an alte roite until it chooses to transform back as a swift action or is reduced to 0 or fewer hit points. Damage taken by the alte roite form carries over to the jura aevis, but negative status effects are removed.
Blind (ex) A jura aevis's tail slap can cause temporary blindness. If it hits, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 29) or be blind for 1d4+1 rounds.

Breath Wing (su) A jura aevis can use its wings to cause a breath-like attack to slice the air in front of it in a 30-ft. cone. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of wind damage, Reflex save (DC 26) for half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

Cold Wave (su) As a standard action, a jura aevis may create an area of extreme cold extending outward within a 45 ft.-cone burst. It drains heat, dealing 12d4 points of ice damage, then 1d2 points of Dexterity damage for 10 rounds unless they make a Reflex save (DC 26) for half damage and no stat damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).
Confusion (su) A jura aevis's bite can cause temporary confusion. If it hits, the target must make a Will save (DC 26) or be confused for 1d4+1 rounds.

Gates of Hades (su) A jura aevis can launch an explosive fireball within 100 ft. which explodes in a 20-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of fire damage and suffer the Burning status effect for 1d6+2 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 26) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

Maelstrom (su) Once every 1d3+1 rounds, a jura aevis can unleash a black, draining wind upon its enemies. All enemies in a 20-ft.-radius burst, with a range of 30 feet, must make a Fortitude save (DC 26) or be reduced to a number of hit points equal to their HD. Those who are already at such a level of hit points or lower are reduced to 1 hit point instead. A successful saving throw reduces the enemy's current hit points by one quarter instead. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 9th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 33).
Poison (ex) A jura aevis's wings are covered in poisonous dust. If they hit, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 29) or be poisoned (1d6+9 damage) for 1 minute.

Umbral Storm (su) A jura aevis can unleash a blinding lightning burst against a group of targets within 50 feet in a 20-ft.-radius burst. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of lightning damage and are inflicted with the Blind status for 1d4+1 rounds. A successful Reflex (DC 26) halves the damage and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Passive or toggleable special abilities that can be represented as buffs also create Foundry buff items.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
